report_name: Law Firm Investigates Data Breach at Infotree Global Solutions

identities.name: Infotree Global Solutions
identities.description: A Michigan-based staffing and payroll provider that experienced a data breach due to an employee accidentally emailing documents containing sensitive personal information, including names and Social Security numbers, to an unauthorized individual in July 2026.

identities.name: Edelson Lechtzin LLP
identities.description: A national class-action law firm that launched an investigation into the Infotree Global Solutions data breach for potential data privacy claims on behalf of the victims.
